title: POST maintenance/reindex
description: Search indexation of the paired shop's products by id, in portions of 50 within budget_s (Spec §6.28). pending: the products PrestaShop marked; products: marks and indexes the listed ones; full: marks every product first. While continue is true the platform sends the same body again with the answer's cursor; a call with a cursor marks nothing again, so the walk visits each product once and ends. remaining counts the marked active, searchable products after the cursor.

cursor.description: The cursor of the previous answer (module 0.5.0).
